requirement: A changelog Highlight carries one still or one clip (mp4 + gif + poster) with its provenance in media.json, or a no-media comment saying why; a stable X.Y.0 prepare refuses a Highlight with neither; release notes and the raw markdown stay text; the docs build writes changelog.json

oracle.invariant: S1: a Highlight with an image or a clip under it ships the same notes as without it; one indented media line per bullet, English alt text, under /changelog/<this X.Y>/, the clip's poster at posters/<same name>.jpg, only in Highlights; the five-Highlights limit counts bullets, not media lines; every Highlight is covered by its media line or a <!-- no-media: <English reason> --> comment (an empty reason, media and no-media together, or no-media outside Highlights are named); notesForRelease of a stable X.Y.0 refuses with the list of uncovered Highlights (file + first words), a dev X.Y.0 warns with the same list, a patch release does not re-check Highlights; a no-media comment never changes the 0.5.0/0.5.1 notes or their sha256. S2: limits are stills 500 KB / 1600 px, clips H.264 2 MB / 10 s / 1600 px, gifs 3 MB / 1200 px / 10-15 fps, posters 150 KB; a file over a limit, of another type or not what its name says is named; a page's media without files or without its media.json entry, an entry or a file no page uses, an entry whose highlight, version, recordedAt, capturedWith or files are wrong are named; add writes webp, or an H.264 mp4 (crf 26) + a gifski GIF at 12 fps + the first frame as poster, within limits, and the media.json entry, and refuses a highlight that is not on the page. A packaged build refuses a remote-debugging switch unless TRACY_DESKTOP_ALLOW_CDP=1 and its channel is not stable; the stable channel ignores the switch and says so. S3: the raw X.Y.md copy has no media line and no no-media comment; changelog.json lists every page newest first with title, released, plain-text highlights, the first media (a clip as its gif) and the page URL, absolute on the docs site; every committed page passes, every image and clip it shows exists, fits and has its media.json entry. S4: prepare of a stable 0.3.0 whose Highlight has neither media nor no-media is refused before checkout or build and writes nothing; a dev build of it warns and ships the page notes; a no-media Highlight lands in manifest.notes.noMedia with its reason while notes.text stays the bullet alone.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
